name: Hilde Vautmans - § 1, point ab - Am 20
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: ab) confirm that the EU’s One China policy is the guiding framework for the EU’s foreign policy decisions as regards Taiwan; oppose any unilateral attempt to alter the status quo by force or coercion; call for dialogue and constructive engagement across the Taiwan Strait to reinforce stability in the region;
